_doc: Morrowmere v2 (final): 'The Amphitheatre Cove'. Shared by Tools/Blender/kg_build_terrain.py (terraces, walls, water, stairs, ramps), Tools/Unreal/kg_build_village.py (buildings, stairs, walls, quay, props, tasks) and Tools/Unreal/kg_dress_common.py (zones). Units: METRES, UE frame (x east, +y toward the sea, z up); UE cm = m*100; Blender uses (x, -y). Plan doc: Docs/Level/Morrowmere_v2_Plan.md. Generated by Tools/Level/author_layout_v2.py; checked by Tools/Level/validate_layout.py; drawn by render_layout.py.

_schema.building: at [x,y] centre; size [w,d] (w frontage along local X, d depth); face = point 4 m in front of the door; face_deg = direction the front looks (0 east, 90 sea); yaw = UE actor yaw = face_deg+90; z = pad height at the front door (plinth down to terrain behind); terrace; storeys; block = party-wall group (members of one block touch, everything else keeps >= 1 m).
_schema.terrace: polygon (closed, CCW or CW); z flat, or z_profile {origin, dir, stops[[s,z]]} with s = (p-origin).dir; edge 'hard' = retaining wall/cliff on its boundary, 'soft' = blend soft_m metres outward. Slope terraces are computed as raw_polygon minus the flat terraces; validate/render do the same.
_schema.stair: from (top or bottom) -> to; z0 at from, z1 at to; risers = |z1-z0| kit risers of 1 m x 2.08 m run; landings share the remaining length; width multiple of 2 m (kit piece width).
_schema.ramp: polyline, z linear with length from z0 to z1; terrain overrides to this grade inside width/2.
_schema.retaining_wall: polyline along a terrace edge; top_z / bottom_z; courses = kit wall courses (3 m).
_schema.lane: polyline + width; z number = flat, 'terrain' = follows the terrace/profile under it.
_schema.landmark: civic buildings/towers as buildings; point props (fountain, torii, well...) carry is_prop=true with a nominal footprint, facing and terrace/z; they may stand inside squares/yards.
_schema.street_join: arch (sottoportego over an ope) or garden_wall (with gate) closing the street wall between two party-wall blocks.

axis.note: Processional Axis. Polar frame used by the plan: P(r, th) = O + r*(cos th*dir_inland + sin th*east).

terraces.name: quay
terraces.note: Quay / Harbour Row. Basin face = quay wall (top 2, foot -3). Back = Harbour Wall (5) and Sakura Wall (8).

terraces.name: heart
terraces.note: The Heart: Fountain Square and three concentric rows. West edge blends soft into Brookside.

terraces.name: garden
terraces.note: Sakura Garden terrace on the lip above the east quay; pavilion on the island axis x = 45.

terraces.name: upper
terraces.note: Upper Town: Balcony Lane with a parapet over the Heart, Well Court, Pilgrim Garden.

terraces.name: crown
terraces.note: Crown Hill: belvedere, church, bell tower, graveyard. Flanks fall as grassy banks (soft 10 m).

terraces.name: brookside
terraces.note: Brook valley: tilted plane falling to the shingle beach, the Morrow Brook cut 1.2 m into it.

terraces.name: orchard
terraces.note: Orchard Upland: apple rows, walled fields, windmill knoll (mound).

terraces.name: headland
terraces.note: Lighthouse Point: ridge rising south to 14, sea cliffs on three sides.

coast.note: Inside = land. Outside = sea. The basin is the dredged water inside the quay/mole/headland.

basin.note: Dredged round basin; ocean waves scaled x0.25 inside the mole (wave mask polygon = water inside coast hull).

_zones_doc: Ordered: kg_dress_common.zone_of() returns the FIRST zone whose polygons contain the point; 'wilds' otherwise.

heart.walls: cream limestone ground floor (Wall_UnevenBrick, pale MI) + white plaster

heart.mood: the living room: meetings and trials

crown_hill.accents: gold bell, purple glass glow, cypress, lavender

orchard_upland.accents: wheat gold, apple rows, windmill, dry-stone walls

sakura_garden.accents: sakura pink, raked gravel, lanterns, koi

lighthouse_point.accents: yellow gorse, rope rails, oil barrels
